market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$99 with 2 months remaining; recent 52-week high was $117.63 amid Feb 2026 Iran/US strikes (one source cites $113.13 spike). Existing geopolitical premium leaves $115 within one credible escalation event. Front-month settle vs intraday spike matters; settlement above $115 is meaningfully harder than touching it intraday.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether tensions escalate into broader regional conflict or de-escalate via diplomacy.
